title: Camila Pitanga and Sergio Guizé Lead the Cast of a New Original Comedy From Netflix
body_markdown:
São Paulo, August 31, 2026 -


Netflix announces that filming has started on its new Brazilian comedy series,


Casamento Aberto e Outras Coisas que Não Existem


. With a stellar cast, the project also marks the debut of Camila Pitanga, Heloisa Périssé and Sergio Guizé on Netflix. They join Samantha Schmütz, Xamã and Otavio Muller in the series.


(Credits: Julia Mataruna/ Netflix)


The series directed by José Alvarenga Jr. was created and written by Alexandre Machado. This series reunites a pair that is well established in Brazilian comedy with previous successes such as


Os Normais


(2001-2003) and other productions.


Casamento Aberto e Outras Coisas que Não Existem


follows a married couple who decides to open up their relationship and explore, with the high spirits, desires, arrangements and conflicts of romantic relationships in today's world. The premiere date is yet to be determined. Episodes are being filmed in São Paulo. The behind-the-scenes video released on social media already provides an idea of the vibe of the series and of what we can expect when a cast of this caliber gets together. Check it out


[YouTube](https://us.list-manage.com/zrrudH_tLf8?e=2cf73c9896&c2id=802affb5df43a1e77a66c07165513599) and


[Instagram](https://us.list-manage.com/17WVJOkNfTk?e=2cf73c9896&c2id=802affb5df43a1e77a66c07165513599) .


About Manas Filmes


Manas Filmes is an independent production company committed to developing projects that tell original, impactful stories. Led by experienced producers Bel Berlinck and Joana Cooper, the company is producing its debut project with Netflix, the original series


Rauls


. Manas is also currently developing original projects and IP adaptations for various platforms.
